# Deployment, Security, and Privacy {#sec-deploy}

![Deployment topology. Source: `docs/adr/architecture/07-deployment-topology.mmd`.](../../adr/architecture/rendered/07-deployment-topology.png){#fig-deploy width=100%}

## Topology

- The **workstation** (Windows) runs `START.cmd` and binds to `127.0.0.1:8000`, so the review API is local to that machine. Its state lives in `local-state/` and in the Workspace folders.
- The **GPU host** (Linux) runs the systemd unit `dr-support-model-api`, which executes `start.sh` on `0.0.0.0:7860` with one worker. It must sit on the protected hospital LAN. TLS, authentication at the boundary, and firewall rules are hospital infrastructure. The optional Bearer token lives in `/etc/dr-support/model-server.env`.
- **Internet** is needed only for `setup.sh` and, optionally, for CVAT Online. Offline acceptance covers `/health`, `/v1/models`, and local inference.

Operational procedures (install, upgrade, backup, restore, troubleshooting) are in the *Deployment and Operations Manual*. They are not repeated here.

## Security and privacy controls in code

| Control | Implementation |
|:--------|:---------------|
| No weights on the workstation | `APP_PROFILE=review` requires `MODEL_RUNTIME=remote` (`dr_support/app.py`). |
| Fail-closed assets | `MODEL_REQUIRE_VERIFIED_ASSETS=1`; `setup_models --verify` checks revisions and SHA-256 before serving. |
| Secrets server-side only | `REMOTE_MODEL_TOKEN` and `CVAT_TOKEN` are read from the environment. The token is redacted and never returned; there is no browser storage of secrets. |
| Constant-time token check | `_ct_eq` in `services/model_api.py`. |
| Same-origin mutations | HTTP middleware in `api/_factory.py`. |
| No absolute paths in audit or export | Admission `source_reference` is `WORKSPACE_INPUT/<name>`. |
| Pseudonymous patient keys | `normalize_patient_key` pattern; the export exposes only a pseudonymous key. |
| Immutable sources | No code path writes to the input folder. Profile deletion removes the catalog entry only. |
| Bounded payloads | 20 MB base64 limit for analysis images; at most 500 annotations per save. |

: Security and privacy controls. {#tbl-security tbl-colwidths="[30,70]"}

Never commit PHI, credentials, model weights, runtime databases, `local-state/`, or render outputs. `.gitignore` covers `local-state/`, `.env*`, `*.pt`, `*.pth`, `*.zip`, `node_modules/`, and `dist/`. See `docs/operations/SECURITY_PRIVACY.md` for incident handling.
